as_told.title: Experiment showing stones conduct electricity across a gap

plain: A researcher named Geoffrey Drumm, who says an alien showed him the true purpose of the pyramids, says that he and a collaborator named Ben ran an experiment on the stones. According to Drumm, when they sent electric current into one stone, it jumped as a spark into the next stone. He tells it as support for his idea that the pyramids were built to work with electricity.
